purpose: Separate synthetic regression fixtures from provenance-backed atomic facts before any Travel Evidence enters a formal Domain Assessment.
formalRules: provenance_backed facts must identify the Observation subject they describe
provenance_backed facts must identify a producerRef
time_fact facts must retain timeFactRefs and must consume rather than recompute Time Engine output
conclusion_shaped facts are forbidden as direct formal Evidence inputs unless decomposed by a separately reviewed producer
absence of an adverse fact must never be synthesized into positive Evidence
Evidence producers must preserve factRefs, subjectRef, ruleRefs and producer provenance
Evidence polarity must be created by a reviewed duty-specific Evidence producer, not by the shared source layer

travelerVitality.requiredFutureSource: resolved traveler subject plus reviewed subject-effectiveness fact producer

travelerVoid.requiredFutureSource: resolved traveler subject plus existing Time Engine void fact reference

destinationSupportsTraveler.requiredFutureSource: resolved destination and traveler subjects plus reviewed relation fact

destinationControlsTraveler.requiredFutureSource: resolved destination and traveler subjects plus reviewed relation fact

routeObstruction.requiredFutureSource: decomposed route-process atomic or reviewed derived facts

safetySupport.requiredFutureSource: resolved safety-support observation subject plus reviewed line-state evidence producer

hazardPressure.requiredFutureSource: resolved hazard observation subject plus reviewed line-state evidence producer

transportDisrupted.requiredFutureSource: resolved transport-operation subject plus decomposed transport state/movement/time facts

nextResearchPriorities: define traveler subject effectiveness fact provenance without inventing a duplicate strength engine
bind traveler void to existing Time Engine fact references
research positive transport-operation Evidence rather than infer it from absence of disruption
